extras: Desktop only. Conflicts with other caret plugins. Respect accessibility settings.
intentEvidence: An animated caret for the Obsidian editor.
motivation: To provide a smooth, animated caret experience in the Obsidian editor, similar to VS Code.
problem: The native browser caret in Obsidian teleports instantly between positions, lacking smooth visual movement.
summary: An animated caret for the Obsidian editor that glides smoothly between positions, mimicking the behavior of VS Code.
